title: 16S data of water hoses
description: Within this study, the microbial community of water hoses, the source water and environmental sites in contact with the water were investigated. This study provides first insights towards the understanding of microbiota of water hoses biofilms in the food processing environment and underlines that biofilms in water hoses are a potential contamination source.
center: university of veterinary medicine vienna / food microbiology
samples: environmental sample; urban association not established
